photos.caption: NASA's video, clock 18:34:50
photos.how: Frame from NASA's video at 162 s; on-screen clock 04/24/13 18:34:50, wanted 18:34:50 (within 20 s; the matrix time plus one day). NASA's as-run matrix gives this test's start as 'GMT13-113   MSG 18:34:30-18:40:20' on 2013-04-23 (`as run matrix!B105`), read as 2013-04-23 18:34. The video's on-screen clock reads one day later than the matrix on every day both cover, the same kind of offset NASA states for this clock on BASS-II, so the clock was searched for 2013-04-23 plus one day, 18:34: it was found 113 s into this video, and in no other video. The fan setting on screen (41, 52) is one the matrix's fan cell gives ('52,42,41', `as run matrix!J105`).
